shortDescription: Office of Surface Mining Reclamation and Enforcement(OSMRE):

children: Office of Surface Mining Reclamation and Enforcement(OSMRE):
APPROVES PERMIT FOR NO NAME AREA WITHIN THE EXISTING NAVAJO MINE LEASE IN NEW MEXICO
SAYS THE NEW PERMIT COULD BE EXTENDED LIFE OF MINE FOR OVER 100 YEARS AT MINING RATE OF 5 TO 15 MLN TONS PER YEAR
SAYS THE PERMIT IS LARGEST COAL MINING AUTHORIZATION ON INDIAN LAND IN A SINGLE PERMIT
